rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something exceeds an amount, figure, limit, or target.

example.english: This bag is heavy enough to exceed the airline's limit.

rows.note: Use this for a casual comparison of amounts or numbers when one is more than another.

example.english: The number of people here today does exceed yesterday's number.

rows.note: Use this when exceeding means being better than something in quality, performance, or merit.

example.english: This new phone's camera can exceed the old one's in quality.
